decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabric sits squarely within the firm's existing design and weaving knowledge, so the firm can read market feedback and refresh variants, although devore patterns are fashion-driven and may rotate out of collections.

Transparent burnout fabric draws on the same burnout finishing know-how the firm already holds, making it easy to assimilate, but as a trend-dependent design article it carries some risk of being replaced in a collection refresh.
This burnout decorative fabric is close to the established offer and benefits from the firm's sampling and feedback loop, though overlap with products A and B makes it a candidate for consolidation.
Velour-like upholstery fabric builds on core upholstery competence and is a durable basic that fits the firm's reorder-continuity model, so the firm can interpret its results and improve it.
Flame-retardant plain fabric serves stable contract and retail demand with technical requirements the firm already understands, making it a long-lived staple in the stocked range.
Satin-sheen polyester lining is a basic stock item that complements the sewing and made-to-measure services and relies on well-assimilated knowledge, so continued supply is likely.
